responsibilities.description: Builds the quarterly beekeeping report by fetching apiaries, hives, treatments, products and harvests from repositories and putting together one summary per region for the requested quarter.
responsibilities.name: Quarterly regional report orchestration

responsibilities.description: Assigns each hive to a region through the apiary it belongs to, so hives, treatments and harvests can be grouped by region.
responsibilities.name: Attribute hives to regions

responsibilities.description: Works out what share of a region's hives are flagged for varroa at the end of the quarter, and returns zero when the region has no hives.
responsibilities.name: Compute share of varroa-flagged hives

responsibilities.description: Counts the treatments in each region that started during the quarter, grouped by treatment product, and labels each count with the product's name.
responsibilities.name: Count treatments per product in the quarter

responsibilities.description: Adds up the kilograms of honey harvested in each region during the quarter.
responsibilities.name: Total honey harvested in the quarter

responsibilities.description: Reads the quarter from the input and keeps only events whose date falls in the half-open range from the quarter's start up to, but not including, its end.
responsibilities.name: Quarter period filtering
